subject: Re: Renewal + isolated analytics cluster for Nova Clinics

Subject: Renewal + isolated analytics cluster request

Hi Marissa,

Hope youre well. Our current Redwood Private environment (eu-central) is up for renewal in late April and we want to include an isolated analytics cluster for PHI processing tied to a separate VPC. High-level asks: 

- Add one dedicated analytics cluster (8xA100 equivalent) isolated in its own VPC/subnet with strict ingress rules.
- Keep current environment as-is for inference; analytics cluster will only be used by our data science pipelines (batch jobs, not low-latency inference).
- Need audit/audit-log retention alignment with our compliance team (SOC2 + 7 year retention for some logs).
- Looking to extend the term to 36 months if we can secure a meaningful commit and a 10-15% discount on unit rate.

Attached is a small usage export and our rough capacity worksheet. Can you share a ballpark for monthly committed cost + any one-time infra/setup fees? Also loop in whoever handles network/topology docs so we can validate egress controls.

Thanks,

Emma Lawson
Head of Data Platform | Nova Clinics

Emma  thanks for the note and the attachment. This is straightforward from a product standpoint; weve seen a similar pattern for other healthcare customers.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provision a separate VPC-forwarded Private environment and stand up an analytics cluster sized to your 8xA100 request.
- One-time provisioning + network onboarding fees apply; I'll pull precise numbers and breakdowns.
- Term incentives: 36 months with a 10% commit is likely feasible; 15% will need a commercial review but we can escalate.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben (solutions engineering) will send a short network/topology checklist and a toggle for standby (warm) nodes vs. full dedicated sizing.
2) Ill draft a preliminary SOW and pricing extract for your procurement team to review.
3) If youre available next Tue or Wed afternoon (EU-friendly window), lets do a 30-min alignment call to confirm SLAs, log retention, and timeline.

Ben, can you advise on the egress/IP whitelisting approach we normally use for isolated analytics clusters and any expected lead time for provisioning?

Best,

Thanks Marissa / Emma  looping in the technical details.

Short network/ops notes:
- For strict isolation we recommend a dedicated VPC peering model with NATless private subnets for the analytics cluster. Control plane connectivity will be via mutual TLS to a customer-facing API gateway we provision.
- Egress: we can provide explicit egress IPs per cluster; if you need per-job firewalling we can add granular egress ACLs.
- Audit logs: Redwood can retain audit logs for 7 years (archived S3 with customer KMS) but there is an incremental storage charge and retrieval SLA.
- Warm standby: to reduce cost we offer a warm standby topology where we keep smaller pinned nodes for cold start; for your batch workloads that can cut steady-state cost ~30% with a predictable scale-up window.

ETA for provisioning (VPC + cluster + peering + compliance config): 4-6 weeks from signed SOW. One-time onboarding fee: EUR 18,000 (network, compliance validation, runbook). Monthly incremental committed cost estimate (for 8xA100 equivalent + management) before discounts: EUR 45,000/mo.

If Procurement prefers a shorter term (24 months) with a higher monthly rate, we can model that. Marissa  can you prepare the pricing options side-by-side (24m/36m/commit discount tiers) and include the warm-standby option?

Cheers,

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
